updates.title: UI design, from zero to fluent
updates.author: Maya Chen
updates.short: A clear, hands-on path to interfaces that just feel right.
updates.description:
Make interfaces that look good, feel intuitive, and work in the real world. A practical guide for curious beginners, from the first principles to your first polished product.

A hands-on introduction to the decisions behind thoughtful interfaces. Build your confidence in layout, colour and typography, then bring it all together in a responsive project.
takeaways: A confident grasp of visual fundamentals
A reusable set of components in Figma
A responsive project for your portfolio
